investigator.method: Bounded Level 1 PASSIVE_STATIC investigation per BOTM-LONDON-SECOND-LIVE-TRANCHE-01: one unauthenticated GET to the venue's official_website (WebFetch/curl fallback), with at most one additional same-origin GET when official_programme_url was directly supplied as a candidate field. No browser, authentication, CAPTCHA bypass, or retry loop.

venue_reference: Upstairs at the Gatehouse — North Road, N6 4BD, London

identity.notes: <title> and <h1> both read 'Upstairs at the Gatehouse'; no cross-domain redirect occurred.

site_classification.platform: WordPress (Elementor page builder); individual shows are ticketed via a third-party platform (Ticketsolve).

probe_history.reason: A single unauthenticated GET to the official homepage returned a <title> and current-production heading that directly and unambiguously self-describe the venue's core identity as a theatre currently staging a play, conclusively answering the music-relevance question without further escalation.

reasons: The venue's own <title> reads 'Upstairs at the Gatehouse – Award Winning London Theatre', and the homepage's featured current production heading reads 'Mammy's House' under an explicit 'Theatre' section heading.

The retained keyword scan of the fetched body shows 142 occurrences of 'play', 16 of 'theatre', and 13 of 'musical' (a genre-adjacent word appearing in production-type context, not evidence of a live-music programme) against zero occurrences of 'live music', 'gig', 'band', 'jazz', or 'cabaret' — real evidence the primary programme is theatrical, failing BeatMapped's venue-level music gate.

evidence.description: Verbatim, byte-faithful excerpt combining <title>, main <h1>, and current-production heading/section heading, self-describing the venue as an award-winning theatre currently staging a play.
evidence.method: curl -sS -L; descriptive User-Agent; single unauthenticated GET; redirects followed; no retry
